title: Experience Kissimmee Lakefront Mountain Bike Tour 2 Hours
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ride along the Kissimmee Lakefront on a fully paved, extra wide multi-use trail with ease on a 21-speed sporty mountain bike and experience the real Florida. On this self-guided tour, you can relax and feel the cool lakefront breeze in your hair as you cruise along the Kissimmee lakefront. Recommended for ages 8 and up.

You'll ride about 2 miles south along the lakefront where Sand Hill Cranes and even a peacock are frequently spotted. Others have seen turtles, rabbits, squirrels, lots of birds and even the random snake. You'll cross over a new pedestrian bridge that leads into the park.

At the park you will find several more miles of lakefront trails, a pavilion in the middle of the lake that you can ride out to for some amazing 360 degree views of the lake, a free splash pad, a boat marina, a fishing pier, a restaurant, a sandy beach, a playground, restrooms, plus lots of picnic tables and benches throughout the park.
